entries.14cf4ba78954636f: Its first basic management policy is “turning assets into business strength,” and it explains that, because stable income and financial foundations from facility leasing in Katsudoki and Tsukishima enable it to invest in vessels despite swings in shipping markets. The warehousing and transport business is presented as characterized by mainly serving diverse small-lot shippers and handling areas where standardization is difficult, and by most warehouses being located in urban areas where it is easy to attract people.
entries.1aa1400b3c317d6d: Based on the ocean shipping fleet development policy and the shift from redevelopment to renovation in the real estate business described in “Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address,” and the revision of the Plaza Katsudoki plan described in “Overview of Results of Operations, etc.”
entries.31fc7f4d372f1bb5: In the ocean shipping business, while emphasizing extending the lifespan of existing owned vessels, it runs flexible procurement in parallel, and it presents a policy of building a fleet of a certain scale over the long term, up to 2050. In the real estate business, it presents a shift from redevelopment to renovation, and the policy for Plaza Katsudoki has been revised from a utilization plan premised on rebuilding to a utilization centered on renovation.
entries.33ca06e41f4c5338: As its long-term vision it adopts “Yokuhakobu,” and in March 2026 it formulated a new medium-term management plan, “Ashitamo Genki” (plan period: April 2026 to March 2029). By business, the policy is: in the ocean shipping business, to operate the Handy fleet that “carries well” over the long term; in the warehousing and transport business, to keep honing its practical strength while creating “tomorrow” through new concepts; and in the real estate business, to support the business foundation and carry the lives of Katsudoki into the future.
entries.34ca797a6c081522: In the ocean shipping business, customers are cargo shippers and peer shipping companies that charter vessels; in the warehousing and transport business, customers are those who deposit goods or documents and those who use transport services; and in the real estate business, customers are tenants of residences and offices.
